messages: Send, read and acknowledge messages between sessions.
messages ack: Mark a message you received as acted on.
messages acknowledge: Mark a message you received as acted on.
messages cancel: Cancel a message that is not yet read.
messages get: Show one message and its delivery receipts.
messages list: List messages and their delivery receipts.
messages send: Preview or send a message to people and sessions.
messages status: Show one message and its delivery receipts.
